title: what matters *now*
dek: A conservative recovery layer across the visible Codex and imported ChatGPT sidebar: preserve history, reduce active noise, and keep the revenue test obvious.

sections.heading: the recovery verdict
sections.body: The active owner is the Lead-to-Proposal commercialization sprint. The Automation Control Center remains protected. Overlapping AI, LinkedIn, Angle Map, GTM, and offer-development tasks become searchable history, not competing active fronts. Imported ChatGPT and ambiguous tasks remain unchanged.

sections.heading: the lifecycle *decisions*
sections.dek: Every promoted item needs a source, decision, proof state, artifact, next action, and lifecycle recommendation.

items.why: Revenue: Zero-Momentum AI Offer holds the offer, research, demo, distribution, and proof state.
Automation Control Center remains pinned and must pass its guard before any lifecycle action.
Unpinning reduces the active queue while preserving every task for retrieval.

items.title: Visible task inventory
items.note: All 82 visible tasks with a label, proof/decision state, next action, and lifecycle recommendation.

items.title: Launch control
items.note: LOCKED, PARKED, NEXT ACTION, and proof boundaries.

items.title: Mission reconciliation
items.note: Reconciles the sidebar, 106-conversation index, and 12 live mission threads.

sections.heading: what stayed *untouched*
sections.body: Imported ChatGPT tasks, unrelated work, ambiguous tasks, and historical artifacts were not archived or rewritten. Sidebar actions require automation-ownership checks. The inventory is a snapshot of what the app returned, not an exhaustive export of every historical conversation.
